CREATE TABLE "public"."apis" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "end_time" timestamptz,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "peoples" text[] DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL,
  "profile_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "slug_url" character varying(30) NOT NULL,
  "start_time" timestamptz,
  "status" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "title" character varying(50) NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "url_base" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "apis_peoples_elem_not_null_c694cff5" CHECK (array_position("peoples", NULL) IS NULL)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."audit_logs" (
  "author_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "changed_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "what_changed" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."banks" (
  "balance" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "profile_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."events" (
  "all_day" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "attendees" text[] DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "end_at" timestamptz,
  "end_date" date,
  "etag" text,
  "google_calendar_id" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "google_event_id" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "html_link" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "location" text,
  "name" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "profile_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "recurrence" text[] DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL,
  "recurring_event_id" character varying(255),
  "start_at" timestamptz,
  "start_date" date,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'confirmed' NOT NULL,
  "time_zone" character varying(64),
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "events_attendees_elem_not_null_75685dad" CHECK (array_position("attendees", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "events_recurrence_elem_not_null_99e061d7" CHECK (array_position("recurrence", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "events_status_check_89084d85" CHECK ("status" IN ('confirmed', 'tentative', 'cancelled'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."finances" (
  "bank_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "currency" character varying(3) DEFAULT 'BRL' NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "paid_at" timestamptz,
  "peoples" text[] DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL,
  "profile_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "tag_id" int4,
  "type" text DEFAULT 'inflow' NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "url" text,
  "value" numeric(10,2) DEFAULT ('0'::numeric(10,2)) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "finances_peoples_elem_not_null_c694cff5" CHECK (array_position("peoples", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "finances_type_check_1d2db729" CHECK ("type" IN ('outflow', 'inflow', 'transfer'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."profiles" (
  "bio" text,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "slug_url" character varying(30) NOT NULL,
  "status" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "url_photo" text,
  "user_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "username" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."refresh_tokens" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expires_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "previous_token_id" uuid,
  "session_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "token_hash" character varying(64) NOT NULL,
  "user_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."sessions" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "revoked_at" timestamptz,
  "revoked_reason" character varying(20),
  "user_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."tags" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying(30) NOT NULL,
  "profile_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "slug_url" character varying(40) NOT NULL,
  "status" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."tasks" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "done" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "end_time" timestamptz,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "observations" text,
  "peoples" text[] DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL,
  "priority" text DEFAULT 'medium' NOT NULL,
  "profile_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "scheduled_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "start_time" timestamptz,
  "status" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "title" character varying(50) NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "tasks_peoples_elem_not_null_c694cff5" CHECK (array_position("peoples", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "tasks_priority_check_389bff97" CHECK ("priority" IN ('low', 'medium', 'urgent', 'archived'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."tasks_tags" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "tag_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "task_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("task_id", "tag_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."users" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "hash_password" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
